column1: Mix the granola, granola butter, maple syrup, almond flour, vanilla, salt and protein powder in a large bowl until the mixture holds together.
Roll tablespoon-sized portions into balls and set them on a parchment-lined tray. Chill 15–20 minutes if they need firming up.
Dip each ball in melted chocolate to coat and return it to the tray.
Sprinkle with flaky sea salt while the chocolate is still wet.
